name: Anima Art & Styles
author: various
description: Anima checkpoints with a softer or moodier look of their own: MiaoMiao Harem (expression and skin detail), Pie Models Cream v2 (soft, glowing 2.5D), Riaku Lab (painterly atmosphere and complex light), Pearly Unknown (muted, moody, semi-real, deep backgrounds) and MyGoo (soft 2.5D with warm, photo-like light). These cards came from Anima Anime when it was split on 2026-11-10. For photoreal people use Anima Realism. Prompt with Danbooru tags. All Anima cards share the Qwen 0.6B text encoder and Qwen-Image VAE.

presets.name: Pie Models Anima - Cream v2
presets.description:
Soft, glowing 2.5D anime with smooth shading. The card uses the author's quality tags and negative. About 22 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

The author asks you to read their settings. They recommend 832x1216, 1216x832 or 1024x1024.

Licence (Civitai): image use and on-site generation allowed; no derivatives.

Baked 2026-10-24 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine v0.42.0, direct submission) on the 2026-10-15 bake's 5 prompts x 2 seeds at 896x1152 against Anima base v1.0 (re-rendered: pixel-identical to 10-15), Anima-2.9B, RDBT b1 and the other shipped Anima cards (F:\Claude-Work\anima-illustrious-wishlist-20261024). The release also ships a text encoder and VAE; both are byte-identical to the shared Anima files (sha256 CD2A512003E2... and A70580F0213E...), so the card reuses those. Author: Euler a or er_sde / normal, 20-40 steps, CFG 4-6, their quality prefix and negative. Median 22.2 s per 896x1152. No Anima system prompt ('You are an assistant designed to generate anime images... <Prompt Start>'): in the app check (a two-character prompt with a plain black hoodie, seeds 11/22/33/44) the system-prompt cards lettered it on the hoodie (Delta Mix 'Prompt Star', CC-Dream 'PROMPT', Pie a garbled 'START'); the same four seeds without it had none of it and kept their compositions. Ordinary prompt words ('Summer') can still appear on blank clothing, on every Anima card. Verified in the app (1.77.0, engine v0.42.0) 2026-10-24 through the agent route: a two-character prompt at 3:4 on 4 seeds (11/22/33/44) and a single-character prompt at 1:1 after the card dropped the system prompt, all clean; 21-24 s each. presets.name: Riaku Lab v1.0
presets.tagline: Painterly light and atmosphere; give it long prompts
presets.description:
An experimental Anima aimed at painterly atmosphere and complex lighting. In our test it was the most different of the newer Anima cards: warm backlight, glowing haze and a painterly finish.

Give it long prompts. The author warns it can be unstable with short ones, so describe the scene, the light and the mood.

The author gives no settings, so the card uses the Anima base card's. About 18 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

Licence (Civitai): image use and on-site generation allowed; derivatives allowed.

presets.name: MyGoo v0.05 (Anima)
presets.tagline: Soft 2.5D anime with warm, photo-like light
presets.description:
Soft 2.5D anime: semi-real faces, warm light like a photo and a blurred background behind the subject. It frames people closer than most Anima cards.

forest919 merged Anima base with their own trained style and character weights and hinaAnima2 R Tweaker v3, with that creator's permission. The author calls it experimental. This card is v0.05, the version requested; newer versions are on the author's page.

Use Danbooru tags, plain sentences or both. The card adds masterpiece, best quality, score_7, highres to the start of your prompt, so you don't need to type them. For a flatter anime look, leave out words like cinematic lighting, depth of field and semi-realistic.

This card uses the author's ER SDE at 30 steps and CFG 4.5, about 21 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card. The author suggests 25 to 50 steps and CFG 4 to 5, with more steps for final pictures.
